verdict.rationale: Synthesia's own AI Assistant turns a natural-language prompt, link, or file into a polished video, which covers generating content by plain-language request. Nothing shows natural language operating the rest of the product: editing, managing projects, translating, or exporting. The Interactive Avatars API and widget are about avatars talking to end viewers, not about users commanding the product, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands work beyond initial video generation (editing, workspace actions, translation and export), detail on how the AI Assistant works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
